name: vertical-phrase-ticker
title: Vertical Phrase Ticker
description: A fixed-height window where phrases slide vertically through like a stock ticker — the outgoing line exits upward while the incoming one enters from below simultaneously, keeping the box a constant height.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Timer Cycle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
